p.write_text('def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h):
        cs=[c for c,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v!=bg]
        for c in range(min(cs,default=0),max(cs,default=-1)+1):
            if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    for c in range(w):
        rs=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
        for r in range(min(rs,default=0),max(rs,default=-1)+1):
            if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    return out
')
